_comment: Small hyperparameters for `make smoke` only (passed via 07_train.py --params, mode cli_params_override, which skips the strict-data-hash lock). ~80 trees x depth 4 x 15 models trains in well under a minute on CPU. Sized so predictions are non-degenerate (varied even on small random item subsets) — a 12-tree model produces constant predictions that the strict Pearson guard in stage 09 correctly rejects. NOT the tuned production params.
